{{Top|leg}}
'''Technical officer''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] within several [[Army/Legends|armed forces]] and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security forces]], including the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="IG">{{JournalCite|12|Imperial Garrisons}}</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="UEK">{{JournalCite|8|Uhl Eharl Khoehng (short story)}}</ref> and the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:RtCA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Reactivate the Communication Antenna|Corellia}}</ref>

In the Galactic Empire, technical officers were [[staff officer]]s assigned to [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] and field commands. In garrison commands, they held the rank of [[High Colonel/Legends|High Colonel]].<ref name="IG" />
